note: The Valorant primer's stated facts: the game numbers no game data API publishes, each once, with its kind (riot-notes, measured, occlara, wiki), its source, the patch it was verified on, the topics a patch line can touch it by, its check, and who or what confirmed it. A fact with confirmed null is never rendered as a number: the primer says its rule in words instead. A wiki fact is rendered only once confirmed. Never write one of these numbers in prose anywhere else: the primer (server/services/game-primer.js) renders it from here, and check:primer fails a number with no source. Re-stamping verifiedPatch after a patch is one edit per fact, made only once its topic's lines in that patch's notes were read.

confirmations.player-2026-10-15: The player's decision 5 of the 8.5 spec (section 18), 15 Oct 2026: the standard economy (start 800, win 3,000, losses 1,900, 2,400 and 2,900, kill 200, plant 300, overtime 5,000), the spike (4 s plant, 7 s defuse with its half at 3.5 s, the 45 s timer, beeps at 20 and 10 s) and ultimate points (1 each for a kill, a death, a plant or defuse, an orb) are confirmed, with the VALORANT Wiki as their stated source. Swiftplay's economy numbers stay unconfirmed and are explained in words.
